questions.question: Where did the Second World Summit for Social Development (WSSD-2) take place in November 2025, which was attended by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya to represent India’s vision of inclusive and equitable growth?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Doha, Qatar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Labour & Employment Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya led the Indian delegation to the Second World Summit for Social Development (WSSD-2) held in Doha, Qatar, from 4–6 November 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Summit focused on global cooperation for poverty eradication, productive employment, and social inclusion.**
 
• **India’s delegation, led by Dr. Mandaviya, shared its achievements in lifting 248 million people out of multidimensional poverty between 2011–2023.**
 
• **India’s social protection coverage increased from 19% in 2015 to 64.3% in 2025, benefitting over 940 million citizens.**
 
• **NITI Aayog hosted a side event titled “Pathways Out of Poverty: India’s Experience in Empowering the Last Mile” during the Summit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Summit for Social Development (WSSD)**__

 __
 
• First held in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 1995.
 
• Key goals: **Poverty eradication, full and productive employment, and social inclusion.**
 
• The Second WSSD (WSSD-2) in 2025 reaffirmed these commitments through the **Doha Political Declaration.**
 
 
 
• **India’s Initiatives Showcased**__
 __
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)** – Free foodgrain distribution.
 
• **PM Awas Yojana** – Affordable housing for all.
 
• **Jan Dhan–Aadhaar–Mobile (JAM) Trinity** – Direct, transparent benefit delivery.
 
 
 
• **International Partners**__
 
 
• Participating nations included **Brazil, Maldives, and ILO.**
 
• Focus on advancing the **2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.**

questions.question: During the 20th East Asia Summit, which declaration was adopted reaffirming the commitment to peace, stability, and strategic trust among nations?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuala Lumpur Declaration.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 20th East Asia Summit adopted the Kuala Lumpur Declaration, reaffirming its commitment to peace, stability, and responsible conduct in regional and international affairs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The declaration was adopted during the 20th East Asia Summit held in Kuala Lumpur.**
 
• **It aims to promote strategic trust and ensure transparent, predictable, and responsible behaviour in regional cooperation.**
 
• **The declaration emphasises exchanging information on regional development cooperation, security policies, and disaster management.**
 
• **It also stresses discussions on the evolving regional architecture to strengthen peace and mutual understanding among nations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• East Asia Summit (EAS)__

 __
 
• Established in 2005 as a forum for strategic dialogue and cooperation on political, security, and economic issues in the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• Members include ASEAN countries along with India, China, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, Russia, and the United States.
 
 
 
• Kuala Lumpur Declaration__
 __
 
• Reaffirms commitment to regional peace, stability, and collaboration among participating nations.
 
• Encourages transparency and cooperation in addressing emerging regional challenges.
 
 
 
• Focus Areas__
 
 
• Regional development cooperation.
 
• Information exchange on security policies and disaster management.
 
• Strengthening partnerships to ensure sustainable growth and peace in the Asia-Pacific region.

questions.question: Where was the 16th International Railway Equipment Exhibition-2025, Asia’s largest railway exhibition, inaugurated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi.**__

__
 
• The exhibition is Asia’s largest and the world’s second-largest railway exhibition, featuring over **450 exhibitors** from more than 15 countries.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s focus on modernising Indian Railways has led to **two lakh 56 thousand crore rupees investment** annually for modernisation.

• __**Amrit Bharat and Tejas Coach**__: New innovations in India’s rail technologies, designed to provide modern and comfortable travel experiences to passengers.
 
• __**Exhibition Significance**__: The exhibition highlights India’s strength in railway manufacturing and offers a platform to showcase the country's innovations on a global scale.

questions.question: World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS) 2025 Inaugurated in New Delhi Strengthening Partnerships for Climate Action and Sustainable Development. The theme of WSDS 2025 is:

options.text: Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS) 2025 Inaugurated in New Delhi Strengthening Partnerships for Climate Action and Sustainable Development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **24th edition of the World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS)**, organized by **The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI)**, commenced in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The **theme** of **WSDS 2025** is **‘Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions’**, aiming to bring together **global leaders**, **policymakers**, **industry experts**, and other stakeholders to drive solutions for **environmental challenges**.

 
 
• 
 
**WSDS** is **TERI’s annual flagship event**, and it has become one of the **foremost global platforms** for advancing the dialogue and action around **sustainable development**.

 
 
• 
 
The summit focuses on "**partnerships** to accelerate progress towards **climate solutions** and **sustainable development**."

 
 
• 
 
**TERI** (The Energy and Resources Institute) is a **non-profit research organization** established in **1974** in **India**. It has been approved by the **Government of India** as one of the premier organizations for policy advocacy, research, and sustainable development initiatives.

 
 
• 
 
**TERI’s key areas of focus** include **energy**, **environment**, **climate change**, **sustainable development**, and **natural resource management**. The organization has been instrumental in shaping **India’s climate policies**, including its National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC).

 
 
• 
 
TERI is globally recognized for its contributions to **sustainable development**, having won numerous awards and accolades for its work in **energy efficiency**, **renewable energy**, **environmental management**, and **climate resilience**.

questions.question: What is the theme of the 9th Asia Economic Dialogue (AED) 2025 which is being held in Pune, Maharashtra?

options.text: Economic Resilience and Resurgence in an Era of Fragmentation
Innovation and Growth in the Asia-Pacific Region

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Economic Resilience and Resurgence in an Era of Fragmentation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 9th Asia Economic Dialogue (AED) is being held in Pune, Maharashtra.**
 
• It is the annual flagship ‘Track 1.5 Dialogue’ on geo-economics, organized by the Ministry of External Affairs in collaboration with Pune International Centre.
 
• The theme for AED 2025 is “Economic Resilience and Resurgence in an Era of Fragmentation.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The dialogue will explore key topics in geo-economics, including Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation.
 
• Economic imperatives of cyber security will be discussed as a major area of concern.

questions.question: The United Nations Convention against Cybercrime was signed by 72 nations in which city?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hanoi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The United Nations Convention against Cybercrime was signed by 72 nations in Hanoi on 26 October 2025, marking a significant milestone in global efforts to combat cybercrime.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This is the first global treaty solely dedicated to combating cybercrime, criminalising cyber-dependent and cyber-enabled crimes, including child exploitation.**
 
• **The treaty provides a framework for cross-border law enforcement cooperation, real-time evidence-sharing, and capacity building, especially for developing nations.**
 
• **It aims to harmonise national cyber laws, promote international cooperation, and enhance technical assistance, closing the gap in global cybersecurity governance.**
 
• **The treaty will enter into force 90 days after 40 countries ratify it, ensuring a universal legal framework for cybercrime enforcement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Treaty Details__

 __
 
• Name: United Nations Convention against Cybercrime
 
• Signed: Hanoi, Vietnam
 
• Signatories: 72 nations
 
• Expected Entry into Force: 90 days after 40 ratifications
 
 
 
• Key Areas Addressed__
 __
 
• Cyber-dependent crimes (hacking, data interference)
 
• Cyber-enabled crimes (online fraud, non-consensual sharing of intimate images)
 
• Child exploitation (sexual abuse, distribution of abuse material)
 
 
 
• Global Impact__
 
 
• Bridges digital gaps in law enforcement for Global South nations, providing them with tools for cyber investigations.
 
• Offers technical assistance, real-time cooperation, and international prosecution frameworks for developing nations.
